title: Astraeus
description: Minecraft multiplayer modpack with additional content beyond van+
body:
# General

Astraeus is a carefully curated vanilla-plus modpack that enhances the world, gameplay, performance, and overall Minecraft experience while staying close to the core identity of the game. It focuses on refined world generation, improved structures, balanced gameplay enhancements, and strong performance optimization. It aims to provide more content and encourage longer playtime.

### World Generation & Exploration


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Astraeus expands the Minecraft world with high-quality, immersive enhancements without overwhelming the vanilla style.

Terralith for advanced world generation

Major structure overhauls through:

Dungeons & Taverns (Desert Temple, Jungle Temple, Pillager Outpost, Woodland Mansion, Nether Fortress, End Castle)

Hopo (Better Mineshafts, Better Underwater Ruins, Better Ruined Portals)

qrafty’s Villages (Bamboo Villages, Jungle Villages, Japanese Villages, End Villages)

Additional thematic expansions: Deeper and Darker, The Pale Garden Remastered, Eternal Nether

Sparse Structures for balanced world density

Integrated shader support via Iris Shaders and Complementary Shaders – Reimagined

</details>



### Gameplay & Combat Enhancements


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Astraeus introduces lightweight gameplay and combat improvements that enrich adventure and progression without drifting far from vanilla.

Bosses of Mass Destruction

True Ending – Ender Dragon Overhaul

AI improvements such as Skeleton AI Fix

Additional creatures from Monsters in the Closet

Equipment enhancement systems through:

Tool Trims

TrimsEffects

Elytra Trims

Magic-related improvements via Easy Magic

Building, Crafting & Utility

Practical enhancements that integrate seamlessly into the base game:

Visual Workbench, Bartering Station, Stoneworks, Harvest With Ease, MoreFood, Copper Rails

Improved anvil systems: Easy Anvils, Anvil Never Too Expensive

Inventory clarity through Shulker Box Tooltip and Jade

Additional utility: Sit, Cobweb, Block Runner

Performance & Technical Optimization

A strong performance foundation ensures stable gameplay even in heavily altered worlds.

Major optimizers: Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Krypton, ModernFix

Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (Fabric)

Very Many Players (VMP)

Additional improvements: ThreadTweak, Fast Item Frames, Clumps

Vast render distances enabled by Distant Horizons

Essential APIs and libraries including Fabric API, Architectury API, Cardinal Components API, Puzzles Lib, Balm, Cristel Lib, LibJF, OctoLib, owo-lib, and others

</details>



### Quality of Life


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Small, unobtrusive upgrades that streamline the gameplay experience:

Better Statistics Screen

Skin Shuffle

No Chat Reports

Let Me Despawn

Debugify

Removal of unnecessary UI clutter such as introductory messages

Comprehensive configuration support through Mod Menu and Cloth Config

</details>



### Summary

Astraeus delivers an enhanced yet authentic Minecraft experience.
The pack improves world depth, exploration, performance, and QoL while maintaining somewhat of a vanilla-plus design philosophy. It provides a stable foundation for future expansion while remaining faithful to what makes Minecraft enjoyable at its core.
